# llms.txt — pheno-worklog-schema

> WORKLOG.md schema + validator for Phenotype repos (v2.1 with device: column, ADR-015)

## Install
```bash
pip install pheno-worklog-schema
```

## CLI / Quickstart
```bash
# After install
pheno-worklog-schema --help
```

## Public API (Python)
- Import: `import pheno_worklog_schema`
- See `src/pheno_worklog_schema/` for the module layout
- Tests: `pytest -q` (target: 30 tests)

## CI matrix
- Lint: `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`
- Types: `mypy src`
- Test: `pytest -q --cov=pheno-worklog-schema --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80`

## Cross-references
- WORKLOG: `WORKLOG.md` (v2.1 — 11 columns; `device` per ADR-023)
- Spec: `SPEC.md` (if present) or `README.md`
- CHANGELOG: `CHANGELOG.md` (Keep-a-Changelog)
- AGENTS: `AGENTS.md` (per-repo conventions)

## Related pheno-* substrate
- `pheno-worklog-schema` (worklog validator)
- `pheno-ci-templates` (Python CI template, local-only)
- `pheno-vibecoding-guard` (HITL gates for AI-pair commits)
